title: Jehoshaphat and Ahaziah
reflectionText: Jehoshaphat did what was right, yet the high places remained. Ahaziah walked in the ways of his father and mother and served Baal. What do you hear in the different accounts of these two kings, where the worship of each reign is named alongside its years?
